rule: Every numeric value in the output must trace to an evidence_used field
on_violation: reject output, regenerate or downgrade to insufficient_evidence

rule: No metric may appear that is not present in the evidence pack
No causal statement unless the artifact states it; otherwise hedge
sources_used must be non-empty and list only artifacts actually read
limitations must always be present and include explain-not-decide + snapshot caveat
Prohibited language must not appear (winner/best/unconditional champion/promote/promoted champion/production approved/automatic decision)
Champion must be described as currently selected under stated conditions, never as winner
Ranking order and metric must match the artifact exactly
Model names must exist in model_universe_canonical; prohibited models must never appear
Forecast Viewer output must echo active filters and stay within the sliced pack
Free-text questions outside the evidence pack must return insufficient_evidence
Intervals/uncertainty described only if interval artifact present in pack
TTL/risk values must trace to ttl snapshot; snapshot date must match run_metadata
If evidence pack empty or fields missing, respond insufficient_evidence and list missing artifacts
Every important claim must appear in claims_traceability mapped to an evidence field or source
